prerequisites.reason: Construct Euler, midpoint and Heun updates from slope evaluations.

background: Single-variable calculus, elementary exponential and polynomial algebra, and basic initial-value problems. Matrix eigenvalues and nonlinear PDE theory are not prerequisites.

description: Constructs classical fourth-order Runge–Kutta from four sampled slopes, compares a worked step with Euler and midpoint, and introduces step doubling and embedded local-error estimates for adaptive integration.
